name: Khaaan!
look: Close-up film still of William Shatner as Captain Kirk, his face flushed and twisted with rage, teeth bared mid-scream. He wears a cream ribbed collar under a dark red uniform jacket against a dark background.
use: An over-the-top scream of rage at a nemesis. The caption names whoever or whatever just wronged you, stretched out like Kirk's famous yell, usually over a petty everyday annoyance.
slots: top caption: what just happened to you
bottom caption: the culprit's name, yelled with stretched-out letters
examples: Someone ate the last slice and put the empty box back in the fridge
My phone updated overnight and moved all my apps
describe: captain kirk screaming in rage close up
star trek captain with a red angry face yelling
william shatner furious shout with his teeth showing
man screaming his enemy's name in anger
old sci-fi movie hero yells at the top of his lungs
origin: William Shatner as Captain Kirk screaming Khan's name in Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan (1982).
